author: nickaturley
text: I'm seeing lots of confusion about ads rumors in ChatGPT. There are no live tests for ads – any screenshots you’ve seen are either not real or not ads. If we do pursue ads, we’ll take a thoughtful approach. People trust ChatGPT and anything we do will be designed to respect that.

author: nickaturley
text:
5/
Our focus now is to keep making ChatGPT more capable, continue growing, and expand access around the world — while making it feel even more intuitive and personal. Thanks for an incredible three years. Lots more to do!

author: nickaturley
text:
4/
Search is one of the biggest areas of opportunity. ChatGPT now accounts for roughly 10% of search activity, and it’s growing quickly. As more people ask ChatGPT not just for answers but to take action on their behalf, we see lots of room to expand.

author: nickaturley
text:
3/
Today, ChatGPT is the #1 AI assistant worldwide, with around 70% of assistant usage. New products are launching every week, which is great — it pushes us to move faster and keep raising the bar for what an AI assistant can do.

author: nickaturley
text:

author: nickaturley
text:
1/
Three years ago, we released ChatGPT as a public research preview at a time when similar AI systems mostly lived inside large companies. We did it because we believed anyone should be able to use advanced AI, not just a select few.

author: nickaturley
text:
ChatGPT is 3 years old today! 

We launched expecting a small research audience. Within hours, the usage was far beyond anything we’d prepared for. Since then, hundreds of millions of people have pushed us to make it more reliable, more capable, and more helpful.

text: 5/ We’ve talked about ChatGPT evolving into an operating system as a layer that connects intelligence to the apps and actions you use every day. Atlas is one step in that direction. It makes the browser itself part of the experience.

author: nickaturley
text: 4/ This is part of a bigger shift. ChatGPT started as a chat window and is now becoming a platform that helps you get things done across the web and in more parts of your life.

author: nickaturley
text: 2/ Atlas makes the web more interactive and conversational. ChatGPT can see the page you’re on, answer questions in context, and help you act without switching tabs.
